Walk In Interview
The interested eligible candidates are invited to appear for walk in Interview for the temporary posts in Research
Project entitled “Climate, Health and Air Monitoring Project’. Posts is initially for one year or till the tenure of
project whichever is earlier. Post is purely on contract basis and co-terminus with the term period of the project.
Post 1: Research Associate (No. of Posts: 1)
a) Qualification:
b)
Essential: ME/M.Tech/M.Sc in Environment Engineering/ Environment Science/Atmospheric
Sciences/Electronic Communication & Engineering / allied discipline from a recognized institution/ University
Desirable: Candidate should have research experience in the field of Environment/climate change / Air
pollution & Public Health
NET qualified candidates will be given preference
c) Salary: Rs. 45000/- per month (fixed)
d) Job Description:
 A self-motivated, multi-skilled candidate is sought to join the project having experience and
research record in climate change and air pollution studies.
 The candidate should have ability to converse, make presentations, write academic papers,
reports and collaborate with interdisciplinary colleagues and researchers.
 The candidate is expected to assist with the organization of workshops, meetings, outreach
activities, and general management of the project as a whole.
 The candidates should have an experience in handing the large datasets.
Candidate should appear for walk in interview along with applications, bio-data and attested copies of
certificates and work experience, publications on Dated 23 December 2024 at 11.30 am in room no 227,
Department of Environment Studies, Panjab University Chandigarh.
Candidate should also fill the Google form https://forms.gle/DK1riqm3CgKgEiz78 before appearing for
interview. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The rules and regulations as laid down by Panjab
University and/or funding agency will govern the selected candidate.
.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Professor & Principal Investigator
E-mail: sumanmor@pu.ac.in
